observations: Two framed photovoltaic solar panels standing upright outdoors against a wall.
Silver aluminum frames with dark cells and white grid lines.
Watermark text 'IZUTECH SOLAR ENERGY' across the image.
No readable brand plate, model number, or wattage label on the panels.
Concrete ground; partial motorcycle and building wall in background.

claims.claim: Seller is Izutech solar energy, specializing in solar equipment such as inverters, panels, charge controllers.
claims.evidence: Seller's text only; not provable from the photo.

risks.risk: Panels may have cracks, delamination, or cell damage not visible at this distance.
risks.proof: Close-up daylight photo of the front cell surface of each panel.

risks.risk: Electrical output is unproven; panels may not produce power.
risks.proof: Video of a panel connected to a multimeter or charge controller showing voltage and current.

risks.risk: The two panels may not be identical in make, model, or output.
risks.proof: Photo of the back labels of both panels side by side.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the specification label on the back of one panel.
Close-up daylight photos of the front cell surface of both panels.
Video showing the panel connected to a tester or charge controller producing output.
Photo of the back labels of both panels to confirm they match.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a used solar panel from photo 0 even without a model number, so it can be priced at its worst case (non-working, unknown output) pending proof.
